entities.name: Ragavan
entities.description: A monkey pirate and partner of Captain Kari Zev on Avishkar, who stowed away on the airship Sun Chaser.

entities.name: Kari Zev
entities.description: Pirate captain and Ragavan's partner; found him aboard the Sun Chaser at thirteen.

entities.name: Sun Chaser
entities.description: Airship crewed by air pirates on which Ragavan stowed away.

entities.name: Skysovereign
entities.description: Consulate flagship crippled by Kari Zev and Ragavan.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: Faction raided by Kari Zev's fleet during the Aether Revolt.

entities.name: Aether Revolt
entities.description: Conflict during which Kari Zev raided the Consulate.

entities.name: Peema Forest
entities.description: Forest of Kaladesh where Ragavan did not fit in.

entities.name: Kaladesh

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: Fought alongside Ragavan in defense of Kaladesh.

entities.name: Keelhaulers

events.summary: Ragavan stows away on the airship Sun Chaser.
Thirteen-year-old Kari Zev discovers Ragavan belowdecks and recognizes a kindred spirit.
events.quote: Ragavan was soon discovered belowdecks by thirteen-year-old Kari Zev

events.summary: With Ragavan's help Kari Zev becomes captain of the Dragon's Smile and raids the Consulate.
events.quote: Kari Zev became the captain of her pirate ship, the Dragon's Smile

events.summary: Kari Zev and Ragavan cripple the Consulate flagship Skysovereign.
events.quote: Their greatest victory was when they crippled the Consulate flagship Skysovereign .

events.summary: Rashmi fights alongside Ragavan to defend Kaladesh in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
The Keelhaulers employ Kari Zev and Ragavan as mercenary guides.
events.quote: The Keelhaulers racing team employed Kari Zev and Ragavan as mercenary guides
